{{Top}}
'''Vos Gesal Hotel''' was a hotel found in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was very popular with entertainers from all over the galaxy. It was located on [[Vos Gesal Street/Legends|Vos Gesal Street]], for which the hotel was named. It was connected to the [[Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse/Legends|Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse]].
